memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'One day He will crush the snake's head.'

sequence.prompt: What did God do on the saddest day? Put it in order.

items.label: God promised a Rescuer would come
God made clothes and covered them

matches.prompt: Match each part of the promise to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Someone will crush the snake's head
God covered what they could not
Jesus, who came to make it right

application.question: God made the best promise on the worst day. When is it hardest for you to believe good things are coming?
application.followUp: God did not wait until people deserved it. On the same day they turned away, He promised to send Someone. And He kept that promise — His name is Jesus.
